chapter: Later views and life in Dallas
title: The Dallas club gig and Adolphus Snead's band
summary: Smith says he enjoys the easy little-group gig, thinks local tenors like C.B. Williams are good, and names the tenor Snead and drummer Fennimore.

story.theme_name: Drummers and drumming: who played what, and how
story.community_name: Great drummers: who they admired and why

blocks.x: That gig that we came to last night, do you actually enjoy playing that?
Yeah.
Do you?
Yeah.
Because it's not very challenging, is it?

Yeah, I enjoy playing that. Yeah, I enjoy that very much. For a little group. Now, a bigger band I wouldn't want to hear that. I would like to hear a little more polished music, a little more late stuff(?), something kind of exciting.
But wouldn't you rather, and couldn't you equally well have a four-piece group in that club, like last night, where they got off a little bit more?
Yeah.
Buster Smith - 219
Wouldn't you prefer that?
Oh yeah. Yeah. Yeah, I would. Yeah. I'd like to have... I know some tenor players around here that's good. They play as much tenor as Lester Young...
Well, you could get Henry Clay. He would be fantastic.
No. Some here are better than Clay.
Really?
Yeah. C.B. Williams down here is somethin' else! No, C.B. Williams is somethin' else around here.
Is that because it's not your gig.
Yeah.
Whose gig is it? The tenor player's?
Yeah, the tenor player.
What's his name?
Snead.
Is he Adolphus Snead?
Adolphus Snead, uh-huh. Yeah, it's his gig.
Yeah, it's a pity. Was he ever with any of the bands?
Yeah, he used to play with me. He never was in no band up in the country.
No.
No. When I first had a big band around here, he played with me a while.
Is he known as a soloist or was he just somebody who played
Buster Smith - 220
in the section? No, no. He just mostly was a section man. He don't care about no solos.
What about the drummer? Has he ever played with anybody?

The drummer is an old dancer. He's a comedian and he's an old dancer. No, he never played with nobody. He just started playing drums the last few years. He's a comedian. He danced and did comedian stuff.
What's his name?
Fennimore.
Is it Something Fennimore or Fennimore Something?
I don't know. Everybody calls him Fennimore. I think his name is James Fennimore.
